from.note: v1-v3 are never edited; v4 is a new file

changes.not_tuned: the margin is the registered formula on A0's own re-keyed rows; no member outcome or validation row is read
changes.unchanged: everything else in v3 (base MWW, A1 only, minibatch 24, no probe, the reported arm, the carried clause (ii)), the readings section and every threshold

evidence: EXP-0070 (v3): A1's monitor gain over A0 = MWWk +25.8 <= F_tr 92.3 at generation 40 (unresolved); 497 / 1000 member scores disqualified independent of raw fitness, on knife-edge worlds (DIAGNOSTICS 28)
v3's margin is EXP-0068's, measured on the TS-base A0's re-keyed spread, not on MWWk's

es.algorithm: antithetic OpenAI-ES: members theta +- sigma * eps_i (eps_i ~ N(0, I), i < pairs) plus the center every generation; per-parameter sigma

base.decision: user, 2026-11-04, 'Re-base on MWW' (notes/user-decisions.md), after EXP-0060 plateau (A0 = TS ~ 128 units below MWW)
base.rule: the frozen base is MWW's keyed whole-order choice (MWWk: weights = makeable units per eligible producer, all ones when none is makeable); the residual is a logit add on the base's log-weights, p ~ exp((log w + Delta) / tau), computed as w ** (1 / tau) * exp((Delta - max Delta) / tau), so theta = 0 draws exactly as MWWk (A0 == MWWk) and an unmakeable producer (w = 0) is never drawn while another is makeable

edge_cases: a missing A0 value (fill None, r_start 0 or None) leaves the v1 test
the comparison is strict: flagged only when A0 - member > margin
applies only to D6's training-time rule (ES members, the probe), never to D7's validation clauses
noise_margin.formula: margin_k = c x sqrt(2) x sigma_k; sigma_k = pooled within-group SD (sqrt(sum ss / sum df), groups of >= 2 values) of A0 across re-keyed replicates r0..r4; run-down: r_end / r_start, one group per world-episode; starvation: a consumer's fill, one group per world-episode x consumer (replicates with a fill only)
noise_margin.not_tuned: fixed from A0's own re-keyed rows; no probe cosine, member outcome or training result was read to choose c, the statistic or the target

source.what: A0 = MWWk at replicates r0..r4 on the EXP-0070 bar's training world-episodes

target.rule: re-keyed A0 (r1..rK) against its own r0 flags <= 5% of episodes under the margin (in-sample)

disqualification.rule: a member's world-episode disqualifies when it dies and A0 does not, when r_end < x * r_start and A0's does not, or when a consumer's fill < y and A0 does not starve that consumer (per consumer), A0 on the same world-episode and keys (the bar's A0 row); one disqualifying world-episode -> the member takes the worst rank; pre-registration v2: run-down and starvation also need the member below A0's own value on that world-episode and key (r_end / r_start; the consumer's fill) by more than the noise margin (strictly), death unchanged; a missing A0 value (no fill, r_start 0) leaves the v1 test

es.estimate: g_j = sum_i (r(+i) - r(-i)) * eps_ij / (2 * pairs * sigma_j)

fitness.B_we: max over RR, MWW (R = 2 mean), TR and the roster v2 deterministic members (bar.csv)
fitness.D_we: mean scheduled consumer demand per cycle (bar.csv)
fitness.formula: f = mean over the minibatch of U / B_we - h * H / D_we

es.noise: eps of generation g: numpy default_rng(int(sha256('|'.join([noise_stream, 'train', opt_seed, g]))[:16], 16)).standard_normal((pairs, n_params))
es.nonfinite: a member whose policy raises NonFiniteChoice takes the worst rank and is logged; never a contract failure
es.rank_shaping: centered ranks over the 2 * pairs members (rank / (2 pairs - 1) - 0.5, average ranks on ties); disqualified and non-finite members share the worst rank; the center is not ranked
es.static_clip_42_stop: a real ES run (probe or train) refuses a bar whose normaliser.json flags static_psi_clip_42 (a 42-producer static count pinned at the clip); the run stops and goes to the supervisor
es.update: Adam ascending g - weight_decay * theta (L2 coupled into the gradient, OpenAI-ES l2coeff)

normaliser.fit_rows: A0's unnormalised rows (after the input transforms) on the training world-episodes of the bar precompute only (horizon 100, agent-history mode, after the infeasible-world replacement): one phi row per (decision, eligible producer), one psi row per decision

fitting_code.covers: the normaliser fit and apply, the input transforms, scale floors and clip, fit-row loading, and the code that builds and feeds the rows (PerOrderPolicy, the shared / history / order / product row builders, the agent-local history)
fitting_code.not_covered: the domain / env state the row builders read (product_stream_view, bid outcome kinds): recorded by each run's package tree hash only
fitting_code.rule: SHA-256 over, per package-relative file in sorted order, the file name, NUL, the source lines of the listed top-level definitions, decorators included, in list order (each '# name' then its lines), NUL

normaliser.scale_floor_rule: a floored column's scale = max(the rule's scale, its floor); floor of psi.eligible_producer_count = log1p(4) - log1p(2), the spread of its two 12-producer values
normaliser.transform_rule: the listed columns are log1p-transformed before the fit and before every apply (policy and fit rows alike); the rest enter raw
normaliser.zero_spread_rule: IQR = 0 -> the column's population std; std = 0 -> 1.0 (all-equal values have std 0 exactly)

note: frozen by task 7.9b from EXP-0071's noise-floor rows, before any v4 ES data; enforced sections from order_es.registered_sections(4), `readings` from order_es_validate.readings_registration() (unchanged)

probe.licence: no probe: the re-based pilot is licensed by the user decision 2026-11-04 after EXP-0060 (both seeds trained above F_tr); a v3 run takes no probe reading

floors.atlas_per_world: SE_w = atlas.standard_error(n_w episodes, differing_w, the compared stochastic arms at their R, the atlas v2 `spreads` of the world's size / choice stratum); floor_w = max(3 SE_w, 0.01 bar_w)
floors.atlas_world_mean: max(3 sqrt(sum_w SE_w^2) / W, 0.01 * mean_w bar_w)
floors.bar_w: validation: max of the read's RR, MWW and TR world means; monitor: the bar table's B_we
floors.monitor_strata: a monitor world-episode is its own world (1 episode, R = 2), stratum (12, its choice), differing from its pattern / shocks
floors.own_per_world: 3 * stdev(paired observations) / sqrt(count), paired per episode and replicate (same replicates pair by replicate, a deterministic arm's one row against each replicate); only with >= 2 paired observations on the world (the n = 1 rule), else the atlas floor alone
floors.own_world_mean: 3 sqrt(sum_w s^2 / n_w) / W, s^2 the pooled within-world variance of the paired observations over the worlds with >= 2 of them (df = sum (n_w - 1)); none when no world has 2 (the n = 1 rule)
floors.rule: per comparison (candidate vs A0, RR, MWW, TR and its shared-only ablation; A2 vs A1; center vs A0 on the monitor set): max(atlas-spread floor at the read's counts, own 3 SE)
floors.tie: a gain at or below its floor is a tie

gains.g_tr: center - A0 on the training-monitor set at the run's last generation (16 fixed world-episodes, replicates 0 and 1, the run dir's monitor.csv, which holds A0's rows in a resumed dir too), equal-weight over world-episodes
gains.g_val: the candidate - A0 on the 12-producer loaded validation worlds (world mean)

labels.computed: at the seed-0 read and again at the final read (both seeds' candidates; a label on either is recorded)
labels.herding: candidate share_swing_consumer world mean - MWW's > 3 SE_w (the candidate's own spread over its rows with swing pairs) on >= 1/3 of the loaded validation worlds
labels.history_inert: |candidate - ablation| <= F_val(ablation) on the 12-producer loaded validation world mean
labels.not_via_deconcentration: candidate - A0 of trace_lead_concurrent_top_share_consumer (rows with >= 1 concurrent group, paired by episode and replicate, 12-producer loaded worlds, world mean) is not below -3 SE (own pooled SE as the floors')
labels.undefined: a measure whose count column is 0 on a row is undefined there and skipped

next.budget_limited: to the user (more generations need approval)

normaliser_pins.check: validation refuses a bar whose normaliser.json `prereg` hashes otherwise, or a candidate whose normaliser is not the bar's
normaliser_pins.zero_spread_rule: IQR = 0 -> the column's population std; std = 0 -> 1.0 (all-equal values have std 0 exactly)

power_rule.estimator: per world, per episode d = mean over the replicates of a - the same for b; s = pooled within-world SD of d over the worlds with >= 2 episodes (df = sum (n_w - 1)); MDE(n) = 3 s / sqrt(n) / sqrt(W); share = MDE / mean bar
power_rule.justification: success needs the candidate above each of A0, RR, MWW and TR, so the read is as weak as its noisiest comparison; MWW - RR stands for a stochastic-vs-deterministic pair (candidate vs RR / TR), TR - RR for a pair carrying the trained scorer; the larger of the two is taken so the choice cannot follow the smaller value
power_rule.mean_bar: equal-weight mean over the same worlds of the atlas bar (reclassified/worlds.csv `bar`)
power_rule.outcome: computed by task 5.4 (`--mode power`) and recorded in sizing.md with this file's SHA-256; never frozen here
power_rule.rows: EXP-0052 confirm episodes.csv on the 9 loaded 12-producer atlas v2 validation worlds (rho > 0.28, class not collapse), entity_planner

readings.probe_interpretation: the probe starts each arm at its registered initial theta (Delta = 0; probe.theta). A2's cosine is structurally lower than A1's: at v = 0 its u block (172 of 268 parameters) has no first-order effect, so its estimate carries noise there. The thresholds read on A1 and are not moved for A2 (A2 < 0.1 with A1 >= 0.1 -> A2 uses R = 2)

readings.budget_limited: no success, and seed-0 read: any seed-0 arm's improvement >= its F_tr; seed-1 read: the seed-1 run's own improvement >= its F_tr
readings.improvement: center world mean at the last generation - at 10 generations before (monitor set; the earlier value from the run dir's rows, or from its checkpoint's monitor history when the run was resumed past it, which must equal the dir's rows wherever both exist); missing -> still improving
readings.kill: the selected candidate has g_tr > F_tr but g_val < g_tr / 3
plateau: (i) every seed-0 arm's last-10-generation monitor improvement < its F_tr (seed-1 read: and the seed-1 run's own)
(ii) |A2 - A1| (seed 0) <= F_val(A2 vs A1) on validation
(iii) the candidate - MWW <= F_val(MWW) or the candidate - RR <= F_val(RR)
success: the candidate - each of A0, RR, MWW and TR > F_val(ref) on the world mean
worlds lost to RR by more than floor_w: count * 6 <= worlds
run-down share (r_end < X r_start) and starvation share (a consumer fill < Y) of the candidate's rows <= RR's
readings.unresolved: g_tr <= F_tr for every candidate read

seed_combination.carry: seed 0 success or plateau and seed 1 unresolved / kill / budget_limited / other -> the seed-1 reading with its Next
seed_combination.seed_1_rules: the seed-1 candidate is read with the same table, selection not redone; clause (ii) from seed 0; clause (i) = seed 0's (i) and the seed-1 run's own improvement < F_tr; budget_limited when the seed-1 run's improvement >= F_tr

readings.selection: among the seed-0 candidates (A1 / A2 or A2-R2), the highest 12-producer loaded validation world mean; A2 - A1 within F_val(A2 vs A1) goes to A1
readings.units: consumer units per world-episode (consumer_completed_units); a world's value is the equal-weight mean over its episodes of the replicate means; a read is the equal-weight mean over its worlds

arms.ablation: the candidate with history_mode shared_only (D9), choice-v1, never retrained
arms.candidate: each run's candidate.json, choice-v1, agent history

validation.draw_key: per-order arms: DrawKey(world, episode seed, replicate); MWW: the gate's replicate action seeds
validation.gating: 12-producer validation worlds with rho > 0.28 and class not collapse (9)
validation.held_out: never played or read here (held-out ledger: task 8.1)
validation.nonfinite: a candidate raising NonFiniteChoice in validation is a contract failure (the run is invalid)
validation.producer_column: none: the user chose entity_planner (2026-10-30, open decision 5), so no EXP-0035-producer column
validation.reported: 42-producer worlds (3 loaded, unretrained), light (rho <= 0.28) and collapse worlds, rho quartiles (nearest rank within size)

plateau_ii.rule: A2 is not re-run (A2-R2 - A1 within its floor at EXP-0060 val-seed0, task 7.6); clause (ii) is carried from that read
